description: ΑΡΧΕΙΟ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΠΑΡΑΓΩΓΩΝ ΖΕΥΓΩΝ ΠΕΡΙΦΕΡΕΙΑΣ ΑΤΤΙΚΗΣ is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΓΕΝΙΚΗ ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗΣ. ARCHIVE ta' l-elektroprodotti tar-reġjun ta' l-ATTIKA. Coverage: ΓΕΝΙΚΗ ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗΣ. The portal shows the English title as "ARCHIVO DE ELECTROPRODUCTOS DE LA REGIÓN DE ATTICA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΓΕΝΙΚΗ ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗΣ. Its keywords include Ηλεκτροπαραγωγο ζευγοσ, Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
